source_definition.provider_name: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City
source_definition.reference_period: Survey reference month; original Excel day is retained but is neither a daily observation nor publication date
source_definition.vintage: Current revised history; annual seasonal-factor revisions can change earlier observations
source_definition.interpretation: Respondents reporting increases minus respondents reporting declines, in percentage points.
